value_policy.rationale: The unchanged upstream per-slot allocation in mm/swapfile.c is the control. Require at least 5% useful gain beyond calibrated noise with passing guards.

selected_idea.bottleneck: In mm/swapfile.c, cluster_alloc_swap_entry() and swap_alloc_fast() acquire spinlocks (ci->lock and si->lock) for every single page allocation, creating high lock contention and latency spikes under concurrent writeout.
selected_idea.mechanism: In mm/swapfile.c, reserve a batch of contiguous swap slots (e.g. 16 to 64 entries) per-CPU in percpu_swap_cluster, amortizing lock acquisition, atomic accounting, and cluster scanning over the batch while safely releasing any unallocated slots on flush/swapoff.
selected_idea.expected_benefit: Amortize cluster lock acquisitions and atomic operations by 16x-64x during swap allocation, reducing swapout latency and contention.
selected_idea.simpler_alternative: Single-slot allocation per folio with per-slot cluster locking as upstream currently does.
selected_idea.falsifier: Reject if candidate leaks swap slots, corrupts swap cache, fails correctness gates, or fails calibrated screening.
required_evidence: Exact-tree independent source review including caller contracts
Fresh probe calibration under Protocol Revision 7
selected_idea.no_upstream_reason: The relevant upstream implementation is already in the frozen baseline.
selected_idea.selection_reason: Directly eliminates per-page spinlock acquisition and atomic operations by batching per-CPU swap slot reservation in mm/swapfile.c.

state.reason: Per-CPU batch tracking uses existing percpu_swap_cluster context without persistent stored disk state.

lifetime.reason: Swap slot and folio lifetime contracts preserved; unallocated entries returned on flush.

locking.reason: Amortizes spinlock acquisition and atomic accounting across batched slot reservations.

error_paths.reason: Standard fallback to slow-path cluster allocation when batch or cluster cannot be refilled.

configuration.reason: No new user-visible configuration or sysfs knobs introduced.

test_burden.reason: Requires verifying slot reservation, batched refill, and flush on swapoff.

memory_cost.reason: Batch state fits within existing per-CPU allocation structures.
